item.title: Rose seeks more 'moments,' beginning this week at Pebble Beach
item.description: After his dominating win at Torrey Pines and trip home to celebrate, Justin Rose returns to competition at this week's signature AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am, where he prevailed in 2023.

item.title: Justin Rose opts for pitch-and-putt day at Pebble Beach
item.description: Rose picked a good day for an abbreviated practice. As the Monterey Peninsula turned nasty late Tuesday morning, flipping from ideal conditions to chilly, 30 mph winds seemingly in a flash, Rose was close to wrapping.

item.title: AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am 2026: First-round tee times, pairings and how to watch
item.description: Here are the tee times, pairings and how to watch the opening round of the PGA Tour's first signature event.

item.title: AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am 2026: Second-round tee times, pairings and how to watch
item.description: Here are the tee times, pairings and how to watch the second round of the PGA Tour's first signature event.

item.title: AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am 2026: Odds, favorites for first signature event of the season
item.description: Rory McIlroy and Tommy Fleetwood make their 2026 PGA Tour debuts at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro Am where they're projected to chase prohibitive favorite Scottie Scheffler.

item.title: Defending Pebble Beach title, McIlroy feels like he's 'playing catch up'
item.description: Rory McIlroy spoke to Golf Channel's Todd Lewis ahead of his first round at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am, his first PGA Tour event this year. McIlroy, the tournament's defending champion, also discussed Tour changes over the last several years and why they appealed to Brooks Koepka and Patrick Reed.

item.title: McIlroy: No need for 5th major, move PGA Championship back to August
item.description: Rory McIlroy told reporters at Pebble Beach that The Players Championship "stands on its own" without the label of being a major tournament. McIlroy, a two-time champion at The Players, believes the tournament has more of an identity than the PGA Championship at the moment and suggested the latter move back to August.

item.title: Pi. Coody leads Aon Swing 5 qualifiers into first signature events
item.description: Pierceson Coody was among five players in the Aon Swing 5 to qualify for the first two signature events of the season, beginning with this week's AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am. The field also includes the Aon Next 10 from the 2025 falls season.

item.title: Charlie Woods, Miles Russell put FSU at center of college golf: Burkowski
item.description: Golf Channel's Steve Burkowski reacts to Charlie Woods' commitment to Florida State and what it means for the college golf landscape. Woods will be teammates with No. 1 junior golfer Miles Russell, who is joining the Seminoles as part of the Class of 2027.

item.title: Following No. 5: Scottie Scheffler wants whatever Chris Gotterup is eating
item.description: Chris Gotterup is a two-time winner on the PGA Tour this year which has earned him plenty of congratulations from friends back home, and a new admirer in world No. 1 Scottie Scheffler
